subject.title: fix: anchor JSON Schema patterns for llama.cpp HTTP server compatibility

question: How should OpenClaw identify endpoints that require llama.cpp-style anchored schema patterns without changing every local OpenAI-compatible provider?
rationale: Locality is not a provider capability, while choosing a provider identity, manifest capability, or public model-compat option affects the permanent compatibility contract.

options.title: Explicit model compatibility
options.body: Expose or thread a narrow model/provider compatibility capability so users or provider definitions opt into anchored patterns.

options.title: First-class llama.cpp identity
options.body: Add a recognized llama.cpp provider or endpoint identity that owns this compatibility behavior and documentation.

options.title: All local endpoints
options.body: Keep locality as the trigger and intentionally accept schema-semantic changes for every local compatible backend.

recommendation.title: Explicit model compatibility
recommendation.body: Expose or thread a narrow model/provider compatibility capability so users or provider definitions opt into anchored patterns.

likelyOwner.reason: The key product boundary is endpoint capability classification in the provider-attribution path recently changed by this contributor.
